Name: HeirloomCrops
Author: great1saiyaman
Description:
# HeirloomCrops

Bring the rich heritage of real-world sustainable farming to Stardew Valley! **HeirloomCrops** reimagines 31 vanilla crops into traditional heirloom variants that naturally reproduce and persist through season changes.

---

## 🌾 Features

* **31 Heirloom Crop Variants:** Covers all standard crops available at Pierre's General Store and JojaMart.
* **Perennial & Self-Sustaining Mechanics:**
  * Heirloom seeds either yield new seeds upon harvest each year or sleep safely under the soil during off-seasons, automatically reawakening when their natural growing season returns.
* **Balanced Economy:** Rebalanced seed pricing to match their long-term value, sold strictly during their appropriate growing seasons at Pierre's General Store.
* **Villager & Quest Rewards:** Acquire rare heirloom seeds as gifts through friendship progression and various village quests.

---

## 📋 Requirements

This mod requires the following framework mods to work properly:
* [SMAPI - Stardew Modding API](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)
* [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Install the latest versions of **SMAPI** and **Content Patcher**.
2. Download **HeirloomCrops**.
3. Extract the downloaded `.zip` file.
4. Drop the `HeirloomCrops` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
5. Launch the game using SMAPI!

---

## 🗑️ Uninstallation

1. Simply delete the `HeirloomCrops` folder from your `Stardew Valley/Mods` directory.

---

## 👥 Compatibility

* Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
* Works seamlessly in single-player and multiplayer (all players should have the mod installed).
